items.title: Ambassador to Senegal Opens Goreé School for Sustainable Migration
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 21 LUG - Italian Ambassador to Senegal Michele Tommasi attended the opening ceremony of the Gorée School 2026, organized as part of the project “Training, Dignity, Inclusion, and Innovation in Senegal,” funded by Italian Cooperation. Organized by the Institute for the Rights of Migrant Workers, in partnership with Inca Cgil Senegal, VIS, and numerous Italian and Senegalese institutional and social actors, the Gorée School serves as a unique forum for dialogue and exchange. items.title: An expert from the Guardia di Finanza at the Italian Embassy in Riyadh
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 19 LUG - The Italian Embassy in Riyadh has strengthened its structure with the establishment of a Guardia di Finanza Office, headed by Colonel Alessandro Coscarelli in his capacity as an expert from the Corps. The opening of the new office represents an important step in consolidating the partnership between Italy and Saudi Arabia, with the goal of strengthening cooperation in the field of economic and financial security. items.title: University Mission to Dakar for Psychology Education in Senegal
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 16 LUG - The Italian Ambassador to Dakar, Michele Tommasi, met with a delegation from the “G. d’Annunzio” University of Chieti-Pescara, which was on an institutional mission to Senegal as part of the preparation of an Erasmus+ Capacity Building in Higher Education project proposal. The mission, which involves Italian, French, and Senegalese partners, aims to strengthen university and scientific cooperation in the field of psychology in Senegal, with a particular focus on the development of education and research. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.

items.title: FIGC reportedly approached Guardiola for Italy job
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 20 - Italian Soccer Federation (FIGC) technical director Paolo Maldini and consultant Leonardo have been spotted in Barcelona, amid reports by Sky Sport that they met Pep Guardiola at the weekend to talk to him about the vacant position of Italy coach. The former Barcelona, Bayern Munich and Manchester City boss is currently taking a break from soccer after 10 years in the Premier League. items.title: GDP up 0.4% Q2, inflation returns to 2.5% in July says Confcommercio
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 17 - Italy's GDP was up 0.4% in the second quarter of this tear while inflation fell back to 2.5% in July, retail group Confcommercio said Friday. The geopolitical scenario, after a brief period of respite, has seen renewed tensions in the Middle East, making forecasts for the Italian economy "slightly more uncertain and complex," "still experiencing undeniable signs of liveliness overall," Confcommercio stated in its latest report, estimating a second quarter of further growth of 0.4%, with a 1.2% increase compared to the same period in 2025. items.title: Sanctions on Moscow won't stop war, hope there aren't another 20 packages - Salvini
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 16 - Right-wing League party leader, Deputy Premier and Transport Minister Matteo Salvini said Thursday that European Union sanctions on Moscow would not stop the UKraine war and he hoped there would not be another 20 packages of them. "It doesn't seem to me that the sanctions have brought an end to the conflict... and I hope there aren't another 20 sanctions packages before we reach the end of this war.
